answers.title: Pehle reason samjho
answers.detail: Refusal letter dhyan se padho. Kya kami thi, wahi se agla kadam tay hota hai.

answers.title: Kami theek karo
answers.detail: Documents, funds ka proof ya jawab, jo bhi kamzor tha, use mazboot karo.

answers.title: Phir se apply
answers.detail: Ek refusal ka matlab raasta band nahi. Taiyari ke saath dobara apply karo.
